modules.name: minisvc.cli
modules.purpose: CLI bootstrap: load settings, construct the repository, initialize the schema, and report readiness.

modules.name: minisvc.config
modules.purpose: Defines immutable Settings and maps environment variables to runtime configuration.

modules.name: minisvc.api.routes
modules.purpose: Registers POST and GET order handlers on an HTTP adapter.

modules.name: minisvc.api.handlers
modules.purpose: Converts request payloads to Orders, persists or reads them, and builds response dictionaries.

modules.name: minisvc.storage.repo
modules.purpose: SQLite-backed OrderRepository for schema setup, inserts, and lookups.

modules.name: minisvc.audit
modules.purpose: Builds in-memory order event dictionaries; it does not persist audit records.

key_functions.name: minisvc.cli:main
key_functions.role: Loads environment settings, creates OrderRepository, initializes orders table, and returns 0.

key_functions.name: minisvc.config:load_settings
key_functions.role: Reads MINISVC_DB (default orders.sqlite) and MINISVC_READONLY (only records a boolean).

key_functions.name: minisvc.api.handlers:create_order
key_functions.role: Indexes required payload fields, casts total_cents to int, saves the Order, and returns a created response.

key_functions.name: minisvc.api.handlers:get_order
key_functions.role: Looks up an order and returns either missing or serialized order data plus a read event.

key_functions.name: minisvc.storage.repo:OrderRepository.save
key_functions.role: Inserts one order with parameterized SQL in a SQLite transaction.

key_functions.name: minisvc.storage.repo:OrderRepository.get
key_functions.role: Queries one order by ID and reconstructs Order(*row).

key_functions.name: minisvc.audit:order_event
key_functions.role: Returns an event dict; no database or file write occurs.

runtime_flows.name: CLI startup
steps: repo.init_schema creates orders table if absent

runtime_flows.name: HTTP create-order
steps: HTTP adapter invokes route callback registered by register_routes for POST /orders
create_order constructs Order from order_id, customer, and int(total_cents)
OrderRepository.save inserts the order into SQLite
order_event creates an in-memory created event
handler returns status, order_id, and event
